subject: Wire phone AI to synced GoalSettings (not local Preferences)
description: PROPOSED 2026-08-07 (follow-up from task 50). The synced GoalSettings entity (singleton: coaching goals + macro/hydration target ranges + cessation opt-in) drives the WEB AI (WebAiSettings → IAiSettings). The PHONE still reads its own local Preferences-based goals for the same IAiSettings values, so phone and web AI can use DIVERGENT targets/goals — a user editing goals in web Settings won't see them reflected in the phone's daily check-in / day-fit advice, and vice versa. Build: point the phone's IAiSettings implementation at GoalSettings (read the singleton from the local DB, which sync keeps current across devices), replacing or backfilling the Preferences source. Decide the migration/precedence: on first run, seed GoalSettings from existing phone Preferences if the singleton is empty, then treat GoalSettings as the source of truth; keep a phone Settings UI to edit it (currently only web has the Goals & targets editor). Ensure the phone still functions offline (GoalSettings is local, so fine). No new entity/migration — GoalSettings already exists on both DBs. Phone-side only (plus optionally a phone goals editor).
note: Done 2026-08-07 as part of the dedicated Goals-page work. Approach: GoalSettings is the synced source of truth; NutritionGoals/Preferences remain a device-local READ CACHE that the rest of the phone (displays via NutritionGoalsCard, AI via MauiAiSettings) still reads synchronously. The new phone Goals page (Components/Pages/Goals.razor, /goals, linked from More) RECONCILES: on open it reads the GoalSettings singleton and mirrors it into Preferences (picking up web edits); on save it writes GoalSettings (syncs up) AND mirrors to Preferences. Seeds a fresh GoalSettings from existing Preferences on first save so nothing is lost. LIMITATION (see task 58): a web goal edit only reaches the phone's displays/AI after the user opens the phone Goals page once — MauiAiSettings/NutritionGoals were NOT repointed to async GoalSettings reads (too invasive). CESSATION FLAG DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: GoalSettings.IncludeCessationData is not written by the phone Goals page (kept device-local on the Cessation page) pending CISO/Security review, since syncing substance-cessation opt-in crosses device→cloud under SOC 2 scope.
